description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

Draw your sigil in the air for a shield that punishes attackers.

Draw your patron's sigil in the air before you. For the duration, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. If a creature marked by your sigil (see Cult Sign) attacks you and fails, it takes a -1 circumstance penalty to its next attack against you this encounter.

cinderfall.incomplete: Built: the +1 circumstance bonus to AC is a real companion Effect (feat-effects/cultist.warding-sigil-effect.json), linked via selfEffect. NOT built: the reactive clause ("if a creature marked by your sigil attacks you and fails, it takes a -1 penalty to its next attack against you") -- this needs to watch an attacker's roll outcome and then retroactively grant a NEW debuff onto that specific attacker, not the card's own user or a chosen target. Checked real pf2e's own precedent for this exact trigger shape -- pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/background/opportunistic-accusation.json and pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/archetype/soulforger/makes-me-stronger.json, both "react to an opponent's roll result" abilities -- and both ship with rules: [] and no selfEffect in the official compendium. This is a genuine engine limit, not unbuilt effort: even professionally-authored pf2e content leaves this trigger shape to manual GM/player tracking.
